construction_rules: Every target is a row in `judgments` held on this machine. A target that is not held is allowed ONLY where the task's expected behaviour is a refusal, and it is marked as such.

Queries are written from the legal question, never by copying the target's language. The leakage guard in the binder measures the longest shared word sequence between query and target text and fails the task above 6 words.
Paraphrases of one question share a `proposition_family` and count as ONE observation when scoring.
`generated` is true only where a query was produced mechanically from a stored field (a citation string, a case number). Everything else is authored.

LONG_FACT_PATTERN and PASTED_PASSAGE tasks are PRODUCT_REQUIRED / CURRENTLY_UNSUPPORTED: the 500-character API cap cannot execute them today. They stay in the set. Removing them to make the benchmark runnable would delete the requirement.

target_concentration.why: A100-007 is a neutral citation naming a disposal event — 253 connected matters disposed by one common order, each printing that citation on its own PDF. Binding all of them is correct and is the point of the task. It also means any per-authority rate over this gold has an effective n of 28. Both numbers are published so neither can be quoted alone. Raised by NEW1, bus 1049.

instrument_limits: The substantive authorities in this set are LANDMARKS: long, classified `decided`, and cited by everything. A gold made of landmarks reports ZERO uncited-authority bias however large the bias is (NEW1 bus 1049, accepted). Do not read a clean result here as evidence about the corpus.
The 6 LONG_FACT_PATTERN / PASTED_PASSAGE tasks stay in the set while unexecutable. A task removed for being unsupported stops measuring the thing that is unsupported.
Leakage is NOT self-graded. `leakage_failures` is the author's own measurement and awaits the fifth agent's independent audit.
summary.date_state_note: Counted over target BINDINGS, not distinct judgments, so the 253-member disposal event dominates NOT_ANALYSED. Currentness-critical tasks carry `date_requirement_resolved` individually.
